hints.title: Shorter Length Combination Counting
hints.text: Any number with strictly fewer digits than n formed entirely from the digit set is guaranteed to be less than n.

hints.title: Prefix Matching and Strict Branching
hints.text: For numbers of the same length, iterate position by position from most to least significant digit.

hints.title: Digit Comparison and Continuation
hints.text: At position i, digits strictly less than the target digit yield len(digits)**(remaining) valid choices. If the target digit itself is absent from digits, stop immediately.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def atMostNGivenDigitSet(self, digits: List[str], n: int) -> int:
        s = str(n)
        k = len(s)
        m = len(digits)
        ans = sum(m ** i for i in range(1, k))

        for i, ch in enumerate(s):
            smaller = sum(d < ch for d in digits)
            ans += smaller * (m ** (k - 1 - i))
            if ch not in digits:
                return ans
        return ans + 1
```

complexity.notes: Digit by digit prefix counting with length powers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating and counting all valid numbers one by one takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: String representation requires O(log N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sum powers for smaller lengths and branch on digits matching prefix of N.
